# Basis {#sec-basis}

This pilot determines the static gravity load from an example engine mass. It
tests unit-aware inputs, symbolic calculation display, table output, section
references, equation references, and Typst PDF generation.

```{python .marimo}
from calcreport import (Q_, equation, equation_markdown, quantity_markdown,
                        table_markdown, u)
```

## Design inputs

```{python .marimo}
m_engine = Q_(3448, u.kg)
quantity_markdown("m_engine", m_engine, "Engine mass")
```

```{python .marimo}
g = Q_(9.81, u.m / u.s**2)
quantity_markdown("g", g, "Acceleration due to gravity")
```

# Calculation {#sec-calculation}

Using the inputs defined in @sec-basis, the engine weight is calculated below.

```{python .marimo}
#| output: false
engine_expr = "m_engine * g"
F_engine = equation(
    f"F_engine = {engine_expr}",
    to=u.kN,
    comment="Static engine weight",
)
```

```{python .marimo}
equation_markdown(
    f"F_engine = {engine_expr}",
    F_engine,
    comment="Static engine weight",
    id="engine-weight",
)
```

The calculated load is nominally referenced as @eq-engine-weight.

# Results {#sec-results}

```{python .marimo}
table_markdown(
    ("Item", "Value"),
    (
        ("Engine mass", f"{m_engine.magnitude:.4g} kg"),
        ("Gravity", f"{g.magnitude:.4g} m/s^2"),
        ("Engine weight", f"{F_engine.m_as(u.kN):.4g} kN"),
    ),
    align=("left", "right"),
    caption="Calculation summary",
    id="summary",
)
```

The results are summarised in @tbl-summary.

# Conclusion

The example static engine load is **33.82 kN**. This is a workflow pilot only;
it is not an issued engineering calculation.
